focus: Post-verification tree refresh for Hadamard 668: retire the failed single-packet H1 frontier branch, promote H2 lag-residue CA as the champion branch, use the LDPC-style defect-graph decoder as the strongest bridge into honest locality, and keep the spacetime row-emission branch closed for this pass.

promoted_bridges.bridge: Lag-residue CA on four 167-channels with explicit family-leakage audit
promoted_bridges.reason: The verification summary and H2 gate now justify the pivot: H1 failed for principled locality reasons, so H2 becomes the champion branch rather than a fallback for tuning.

promoted_bridges.bridge: LDPC-style decoder graph on a lag/check influence graph
promoted_bridges.reason: The saved reframings and the probe both point to Tanner-like defect graphs as the most defensible locality scaffold once raw q/s adjacency is falsified.

retired_bridges.bridge: Current single-packet defect-syndrome CA on the q/s packet lattice
retired_bridges.reason: Retired after the first matched frontier kill test: no seed improvement, support diffusion on every restart, and a frozen one-packet and two-packet neighborhood.

retired_bridges.bridge: Generative spacetime row-emission CA rule search
retired_bridges.reason: Kept closed for this pass because prior-art overlap remains high and the post-verification evidence favors a representation pivot before any generative expansion.

next_experiments.name: H2 lag-residue exact-delta pilot
next_experiments.goal: Implement one lag-residue representation with exact delta tables and verify that lag-local moves can be mapped back without whole-spectrum rescans.

next_experiments.name: LDPC or Tanner defect-graph prototype
next_experiments.goal: Build a sparse defect/check graph from the same lag or packet deltas and compare weighted bit-flip, collective bit-flip, and graph-CA updates under identical accounting.

next_experiments.name: Matched lag-space control batch
next_experiments.goal: Run one non-CA lag-space control alongside H2 on the same seed, budget, restart count, and exact-hit gate.

next_experiments.name: Family-leakage audit
next_experiments.goal: Reject or relabel trajectories that collapse into Williamson, Turyn, Goethals-Seidel, cocyclic, or block-circulant structure.
